interpretation.classification_reasoning: The telemetry reveals conflicting indicators that prevent a single load classification. Maximum dwell time (100.0) with zero errors suggests intrinsic load from careful deliberation on signup requirements, yet highly inefficient mouse trajectories (98.5 score, 0.01 efficiency ratio) strongly indicate extraneous visual search. This combination of intense reading or evaluation with erratic pointer tracking points to multiple co-occurring load types rather than a unified source.
interpretation.hypothesis: It is hypothesized that the interface layout induces both intrinsic load from evaluating complex signup requirements and extraneous load from spatial visual search, driving high dwell times and erratic mouse tracking without causing critical task failures.
